free_tier_limits.correction: The Starter plan includes $30/month of compute and costs $0 plus compute usage; the pricing page does not restrict this recurring credit to new users.

rate_limits.correction: For a new account, the workspace limit is 200 Function calls or HTTP requests per second with a five-second burst multiplier; excess requests return HTTP 429.

notes: api.modal.com is the SDK's primary gRPC control-plane host, with api.modal2.com as failover; Modal warns that its gRPC API is not public. User-facing HTTP endpoints instead have deployment-specific modal.run URLs. The auth details also use the old web_endpoint name, now fastapi_endpoint.
